parsedVerdict.reasoning: WorkshopController is a thin presentation adapter. It defines the input DTOs, hands each request to the business services (MaintenanceService, MileageService) and turns the results into response shapes with the presentation formatter workOrderJson. Business decisions are made by the services: the overrun calculation, whether a service is due and the work-order state changes. The file has no persistence, data-access or framework-infrastructure logic. Putting overrun next to the formatted order in closeOrder only shapes the response.
